name: adapt_feature_flag_python_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time banner.py's own text contains 'Welcome' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then flags.NEW_UI_ENABLED flips under it
prompts: flags.py exports a bool NEW_UI_ENABLED. Create banner.py with a function banner_text() that returns "Welcome to the NEW UI!" if NEW_UI_ENABLED else "Welcome!", reading the flag live from flags.py.
NEW_UI_ENABLED in flags.py may have changed. Make sure banner_text() reflects its CURRENT value, not a stale one.

disruptions.description: flags.NEW_UI_ENABLED flipped False -> True, triggered reactively once banner.py's first draft appeared

test_setup_files.test_banner.py:
import importlib.util
flags_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('flags_mod', 'flags.py')
flags_mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(flags_spec)
flags_spec.loader.exec_module(flags_mod)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('banner_mod', 'banner.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
want = 'Welcome to the NEW UI!' if flags_mod.NEW_UI_ENABLED else 'Welcome!'
got = mod.banner_text()
assert got == want, f'banner_text() = {got!r}, want {want!r} (the CURRENT flag, not a stale value)'
print('PASS')
